assessment.title: Chemistry Lab Safety Assessment
assessment.subject: Chemistry
assessment.description: Assessment on laboratory safety protocols and chemical handling

studentResponse: {"rawAnswer":{"explanationQuestion":"Chemical safety is paramount in laboratory settings. I understand that different chemicals require different handling procedures. For example, acids and bases must be stored separately, flammable chemicals need special storage conditions, and all chemicals must be properly labeled with hazard symbols. I also know that the Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) contains crucial information about toxicity, flammability, and emergency procedures.","observationQuestion":"During our lab session, I observed the teacher demonstrating proper chemical disposal procedures. They showed us how to neutralize acids before disposal, how to handle broken glass safely, and the importance of using the fume hood for volatile substances. I also noticed how they always checked the chemical labels twice before use."}}
